markets.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if the central bank announces its decision.
markets.rules_primary: If the Bank of England takes the action of Maintain current rate at the September Monetary Policy Committee meeting, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary: The market resolves based on the official policy rate decision announced by the central bank. For central banks with multiple policy rates, only changes to the primary policy rate count. If the meeting is cancelled or delayed past the expiration date, markets for "No change" resolve to Yes and all others resolve to No. Emergency rate changes between scheduled meetings do not affect resolution of contracts tied to scheduled meetings. The specific basis point ranges are inclusive (e.g., "25-50bp" includes both 25bp and 50bp changes).
markets.title: Will the Bank of England Maintain current rate at the September Monetary Policy Committee meeting?

markets.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if the economic data is released.
markets.rules_primary: If United Kingdom Inflation Rate YoY is above Euro Area Inflation Rate YoY for August 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary: Only the first non-preliminary value reported for each measure will be used. For the Euro Area, any flash or preliminary estimate does not qualify. The values will be compared as published in percent. A tie resolves No, and subsequent revisions will not affect resolution.
markets.title: Will United Kingdom Inflation Rate YoY exceed Euro Area Inflation Rate YoY for August 2026?
